Arrhenius.description: Arrhenius factor k0·exp(−Ea/(R·T)) with Ea in J/mol.
Arrhenius.title: Arrhenius

Axis.description:
One swept address and the values it takes; every combination with the
other axes (the full grid) becomes one case.
Axis.title: Axis

BlockRecord.description:
Execution record of one strongly connected component (block).

An acyclic block runs once (``iterations == 1``, no tears, no records); a
cyclic block records one :class:`TearRecord` per tear stream per pass, so
``len(records) == iterations * len(tears)``. A block with a failed unit, or
one that could not run at all (a blocked inlet), stops and is marked
``converged=False``. ``wall_s`` is timing telemetry: two runs of the same
flowsheet produce the same record except for it, so equality and hashing
ignore it - the double-run determinism oracles compare whole solved models.
BlockRecord.title: BlockRecord

CaseStudyRequest.description:
The ``POST /api/study`` body: a :class:`CaseStudy` without ``base`` -
the route fills it from the current project's flowsheet.
CaseStudyRequest.title: CaseStudyRequest

CellSet.description: A value with an optional unit (converted to the cell's declared unit).
CellSet.title: CellSet

Change.description: One recorded project change: who, what, and the structured diff.
Change.title: Change

Citation.description: Where a number or a method comes from.
Citation.title: Citation

Component.description:
One physical item. start->end is the centerline in flow direction.

For elbows, `center` is the intersection point of the two legs.
For tees, `branch_end` is the branch connection point.
Component.title: Component

Datasheet.description: Sizing output for one piece of equipment.
Datasheet.title: Datasheet

DesignSpec.description:
One design specification: drive ``target`` to ``value`` via ``manipulated``.

``target`` and ``manipulated`` are variable addresses (grammar in
``ngdesign.variables``); the flowsheet validator checks they parse and that
their heads name a stream or unit of the sheet. ``tolerance`` is relative on
the target: converged when ``|achieved - value| <= tolerance * |value|``.
DesignSpec.title: DesignSpec

DesignSpecResult.description:
One design spec's outcome after the outer loop (spec P2-01).

``history`` holds one ``(manipulated, achieved)`` pair per outer iteration
that produced a solvable flowsheet. On convergence ``achieved`` is the last
iteration's value; otherwise it is the closest value any iteration reached
(with ``manipulated_value`` the manipulated variable that produced it). A
spec aborted by a failed inner solve has ``converged=False``; if no
iteration ever solved, ``achieved`` and ``manipulated_value`` are NaN.
DesignSpecResult.title: DesignSpecResult

DrivingForceTerm.description: One additive term of an LHHW numerator/denominator block.
DrivingForceTerm.title: DrivingForceTerm

Equilibrium.description: Equilibrium model of one reaction: Gibbs-driven or a ln K polynomial.
Equilibrium.title: Equilibrium

FeedIn.description: Boundary feed conditions in SI (K, Pa abs, mol/s, mole fractions).
FeedIn.title: FeedIn

FeedSpec.description: Boundary feed conditions; the solver flashes this into a StreamState.
FeedSpec.title: FeedSpec

GridIn.description: An axial cell (q, r) of the flowsheet canvas's flat-top hex lattice.
GridIn.title: GridIn

Job.description: One solve job: identity, project binding, lifecycle, progress.
Job.title: Job

Layout.description: User placements per view, keyed by tag. A missing tag means: auto-layout decides.
Layout.title: Layout

Mutation.description:
Every mutating v1 call answers with the operation result and the change
it committed (``null`` when the write changed nothing).
Mutation.title: Mutation

Nozzle.description: A connection point on equipment. Position is relative to the equipment origin (mm).
Nozzle.title: Nozzle

PowerLaw.description:
Power-law rate expression.

``reverse`` carries the explicit reverse expression; without it a reaction
with an equilibrium model is equilibrium-limited, and without either the
expression is irreversible. The reverse side is a plain ``PowerLawRate``
body — it never nests a further ``reverse`` (detailed balance points its
forward side at this reaction, so a reverse-of-reverse has no physical
meaning). Keeping the graph acyclic also matters mechanically: a recursive
model makes FastAPI's request/response OpenAPI schemas textually
irreconcilable (`<Model>-Input`/`<Model>-Output` self-references), which
split and renamed every component the frontend types import.
PowerLaw.title: PowerLaw

PowerLawRate.description:
Power-law rate body: Arrhenius term plus composition orders.

``PowerLaw`` without the ``reverse`` slot. Splitting the body out keeps the
contract model graph non-recursive (see ``PowerLaw.reverse``).
PowerLawRate.title: PowerLawRate

ProjectCreate.description:
POST /api/projects body: a name plus at most one source — an explicit
``project`` body (import), a catalogue ``template`` id, or ``from_project``
(the id of another of the caller's projects to copy). No source: blank.
ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate

ProjectInfo.description: A stored project: identity, audit stamp, version, origin and the body.
ProjectInfo.title: ProjectInfo

PseudoDefinition.description:
A flowsheet-owned pseudo-component characterization (spec P1-07).

The Tb + sg pair drives the Lee-Kesler / Riazi-Daubert correlations; each of
``mw`` / ``Tc`` / ``Pc`` / ``omega`` may be overridden explicitly, and every
override carries its own provenance note in ``provenance``. A pseudo id may
not shadow a curated id (the Flowsheet validator rejects it).
PseudoDefinition.title: PseudoDefinition

Reaction.description:
One stoichiometric reaction with optional kinetics and equilibrium model.

``base_component`` is the component the extent of reaction is normalized
on; it must appear with ν < 0. Pseudo (lumped) components can only take
part in reactions explicitly marked ``lumped``, which switches validation
from element balances to a molecular-weight balance (pseudos carry no
formula). ``provenance`` is mandatory: every reaction names where its
stoichiometry and data come from.
Reaction.title: Reaction

ReactionSet.description:
A flowsheet-owned set of reactions over its own component slate.

The slate is self-describing so a saved project carries everything needed
to replay it; the flowsheet slate may be wider. Lumped reactions are
validated on a molecular-weight balance instead of element counts.
ReactionSet.title: ReactionSet

SolverOptions.description:
Per-flowsheet tear-solver settings (spec P2-03).

One flowsheet owns its own tear-solving behaviour instead of the solver
module keeping three module constants: the iteration cap, the relative
tolerance and the acceleration all come from here at solve time. The
defaults are the spec S-30 values the solver used before options existed -
a flowsheet that never mentions ``solver_options`` solves exactly as it
always did, and saved projects carry the block only when they want
something different.
SolverOptions.title: SolverOptions

StreamCreate.description:
A feed (``source`` omitted: ``target`` + ``feed``), a connection (both
ends) or a product (``target`` omitted).

id.description: Stream id; omitted: next free S-NNN
id.title: Id

service.description: Fluid code: PG, PL, W, GL
service.title: Service

StreamCreate.title: StreamCreate

StreamSpec.description: A stream between two ports. source=None means a feed; target=None means a product.
StreamSpec.title: StreamSpec

StreamState.description: Fully specified thermodynamic state of a stream.
StreamState.title: StreamState

StudyResult.description:
Every case's row in sweep order. ``failed`` is the subset of rows whose
``status`` is ``"failed"``: the same rows, singled out for the caller.
StudyResult.title: StudyResult

StudyRow.description:
One case of the grid: its inputs, its read outputs and how it solved.

``status`` mirrors the case's :class:`~ngdesign.contracts.SolvedFlowsheet`
``status`` (spec P2-02); ``errors`` carries the case's ``UnitError`` list.
``message`` is set (and ``errors`` empty) when the case failed before any
unit ran: a write address :func:`~ngdesign.variables.assign` rejected -
the exception's text names the mistake. An output address the case cannot
answer reads ``None``.
StudyRow.title: StudyRow

TearRecord.description:
One tear stream's residuals at one tear iteration.

``residual_vector`` holds the same relative measure the convergence test
uses, ``|y - x| / max(|x|, 1.0)``, keyed by component id then ``"T"`` and
``"P"`` (the tear vector's variable order, spec P1-02 slate order).
``acceleration`` names the step taken at this iteration; ``q`` is the
clamped Wegstein factor of the variable with the largest residual, ``None``
for direct substitution.
TearRecord.title: TearRecord

TemplateInfo.description: One new-project template: catalogue id, display text and its size.
TemplateInfo.title: TemplateInfo

ToolRun.description: A tool run's output: the result plus the change of a mutating tool.
ToolRun.title: ToolRun

params.description: Unit params (SI, see the kind's param schema)
params.title: Params

tag.description: Tag like V-102; omitted: next free tag from the P&ID symbol
tag.title: Tag

UnitError.description:
One unit's failure or skip, as data instead of an aborting exception.

``error_type`` is the exception class name; it is ``""`` for an upstream
skip, where no exception occurred - the unit was skipped because an inlet
stream had no state (its source unit failed or was skipped).
UnitError.title: UnitError

replace.description: true: replace all params; false: merge
replace.title: Replace

UnitResult.description: What a unit plugin returns from solve().
UnitResult.title: UnitResult

Vec3.description: 3D vector / point. Piping geometry uses millimetres.
Vec3.title: Vec3

info.description:
Stomato: an open steady-state chemical process simulator and the engineering
deliverables (PFD, P&ID, piping, isometrics) generated from one model.

**Public API v1** lives under `/api/v1` (tags below). It covers the catalogue,
projects, thermo package and components, units (place/move/configure/delete),
streams, cells (any writable variable, with units), design specs, solve (sync
and queued jobs), results, provenance (trace and explain), exports, the change
history (undo/redo and a live SSE change stream) and the agent tools. Every
mutation answers `{result, change}` where `change` carries the actor and a
structured diff; every error answers
`{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when the server sets `STOMATO_API_TOKENS`
(open in local development). `X-Stomato-Actor` attributes your changes.

The unversioned `/api/...` routes serve the web app and are kept stable but are
not part of the public contract. Agents can use the same tools over MCP:
`stomato-mcp` (see docs/mcp.md).
info.title: Stomato API
